summary.text: LØITEN ALMENNING is an association registered in Løten, founded 1836-08-12. LØITEN ALMENNING engages in forestry operations and outfield (utmark) industry. It was previously named LØITEN BYGDEALMENNING until 1997-05-07. Its main industry code is 02.200: logging. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 74 765 000 NOK and the annual result was 13 717 000 NOK; operating income was down from 82 835 686 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 25 604 702 NOK in 2024 to 13 717 000 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 174 271 847 NOK in 2024 to 177 996 000 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is loitenalmenning.no, which links to its Facebook profile. The latest news on its own website is "Snøbrøyting vintersesongen 2026-2027" from 2026-10-12. The registered employee count went from 22 on 2025-12-13 to 43 on 2026-09-15. The register's most recent update was on 2026-09-15 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
